title: Beige Wool
description: Adds a beige color set to Minecraft, including wool, dye, concrete, concrete powder, and terracotta.
body:
Beige Wool adds a brand-new beige color to Minecraft!

This mod introduces several beige-themed blocks and items to expand your building possibilities:

🧶 Beige Wool
🎨 Beige Dye
🧱 Beige Concrete
🌫️ Beige Concrete Powder
🏺 Beige Terracotta

The beige color is perfect for cozy houses, modern builds, natural decorations, and sandstone-inspired structures.

Features
New Beige Dye
New Beige Wool
New Beige Concrete
New Beige Concrete Powder
New Beige Terracotta
Why Beige?

Minecraft has many colors, but beige is missing. This mod fills that gap by adding a soft and versatile color that blends well with many building styles.

Compatibility
Minecraft Java Edition
Works alongside vanilla colors and blocks
Lightweight and simple

Bring a warm and elegant touch to your world with Beige Wool!
